recipes.title: Dry ginger, coriander, chia & ghee warm drink
recipes.portion: ⅓ teaspoon dry ginger powder + soaked coriander seeds + soaked chia seeds + 1 teaspoon ghee + warm water
instructions: Combine the dry ginger powder, soaked coriander seeds, soaked chia seeds and ghee with warm water.
recipes.notes: Recommended both for morning tea and the night drink; the night serving is 30 minutes before bed.
needs_confirmation: Amounts of coriander seeds and chia seeds, and volume of water were not provided.
recipes.source_text: 1/3 teaspoon dry ginger powder ,soaked coriander seeds, soaked chia seeds with one teaspoon ghee and warm water

recipes.title: Peeled apple with cinnamon, honey & black salt
instructions: Peel the apple and cut it into very small pieces.
Add cinnamon powder, honey and black salt.
recipes.notes: Eat within 30 minutes of the morning tea.

recipes.title: Buttery potato with quinoa or rice
recipes.portion: 100 grams boiled potato + 100 grams boiled quinoa OR rice
ingredients: 100 grams boiled quinoa OR 100 grams boiled rice
instructions: Sauté the boiled potato and boiled quinoa or rice with butter, salt and black pepper.
recipes.alternatives: Choose quinoa OR rice; do not treat these as two simultaneous portions.
recipes.notes: The source specifies the potato and quinoa/rice as boiled.
recipes.source_text: 100 grams boiled potato + 100gm boiled quinoa/rice sauted with butter, salt and black pepper

recipes.title: Pongal with moong dal, jeera & pepper
ingredients: A little kishmish (raisins; quantity not specified)
instructions: Boil the rice and moong dal in a pressure cooker.
For the tadka, roast a little kishmish, cashews, jeera and black pepper.
Half-crush the roasted jeera and black pepper.
Mix the tadka with the cooked rice and dal, pour ghee over it and serve.
recipes.notes: Same recipe is an option for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Do not interpret this as three servings per day.
needs_confirmation: The source does not specify whether the 70 g rice and 100 g moong dal are weighed raw or cooked.
Quantity of ghee, raisins and cashews was not specified.
recipes.source_text: Pongal recipe — take 70 gram rice 100 gm moong daal boil it in cooker than for tarka lit bit Kismiss lit bit cashews half teaspoon jeera n 10 se 12 Dane of black pepper rost it n than jeera aur black pepper ko half crushed kr lo n mix it well with rice n pore ghee on that n have it

recipes.title: Spiced rasam
recipes.portion: 1 coffee mug water + “one half spoon” of prepared rasam powder
ingredients: “One half spoon” prepared rasam powder (spoon size not specified)
instructions: Dry-roast the ingredients listed for the rasam powder together.
Prepare the rasam powder from the roasted mixture.
Take one coffee mug of water, add “one half spoon” of this powder and boil.
recipes.notes: The original wording says “corridors”; this has not been silently changed to coriander. Confirm the original instruction. Similarly “one half spoon” is not assumed to mean ½ teaspoon or ½ tablespoon.
needs_confirmation: Does “one half spoon” mean ½ tsp, ½ tbsp or another spoon size?
The size of the coffee mug was not specified.
recipes.source_text: Rasam - One teaspoon corridors one teaspoon urad dal safed two red chilies half teaspoon black pepper two teaspoons moong dal 1/3 teaspoon on hing dry roaste these all together than, Take one coffee mug of water put it one half spoon these rasm powder, N boil it n sip it hot
